notes.title: New Gameplay Overview Trailer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/e49c15f20f0b5eb56bf4950ef41db0772b804b08.jpg[/img]
[h3]Watch the latest trailer, featuring our game director Kris and a very special guest, explaining what Kriegsfront Tactics is all about.[/h3]

[h3]Salute, Pilots![/h3]
[b][i]We teased more awesome things and what's to be expected in Kriegsfront Tactics in this latest trailer.[/i][/b]

It's been a while since our last announcement. We hope all the pilots are doing well and are prepared for the next deployment. Welcoming the year 2025, our latest Krieger news brings you a deep overview of Kriegsfront Tactics, where we showcase the main features, gameplay loop, and exclusive commentary.

[h3]Watch the gameplay overview trailer here 👇[/h3]
[previewyoutube=PSbr4C42z0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]No hit chances. No mercy. Just tactics, firepower, and survival 🔥[/h3]
Our game director and CEO of Toge Productions, Kris Antoni, explains the features, gameplay loop details, the squad system, and many more in the trailer.

[b][i]The trailer also includes exclusive commentary from Toshiro Tsuchida, the creator of Front Mission.[/i][/b] We're incredibly honored by his support for Kriegsfront Tactics—his work has been one of the major sources of inspiration for our project. 

Kriegsfront Tactics took place in an alternate 1970s Southeast Asia, where you, as the commander, must survive behind enemy lines. If you're a classic tactical mecha combat fan, you will be familiar with all the features we bring to the title. 

The war-torn jungles of Nusanesia are your playground. Manage your squad, plan out your survival, and decide when to fight or flee. The more battles you fight, the harder it is for your squad to survive and maintain their Krieger mechs. 

[h3]Look foward to more updates![/h3]
Thank you for your continuous support, Pilots! We are very excited to show you more Krieger news to be announced later this year. Keep on your toes, and look forward to the next update drop!

notes.title: Closing the Year with Event Recaps. We Appreciate Your Visit, Pilots!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/a1d685639ce49da77ee813b80599b780ba805f2d.png[/img]
[h2]We appreciate all the pilots who visited our booth at the events we attended this year![/h2]

[h3]Salute, Pilots![/h3]
[b][i]Recruiting more pilots around the world by visiting multiple gaming events with Kriegsfront Tactics![/i][/b]

Closing out 2024 marks the second year we announced Kriegsfront Tactics on Steam. This year in July, we also launched the vertical slice prologue (with more features coming soon!).It’s been an incredible journey reaching this point, creating a passion project as a spiritual successor to the classics. To share our passion to eager pilots, we did a visit to multiple gaming conventions where we showcased the latest build of Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue, which also available to play for free on Steam.  

[h2][url=https://x.com/togeproductions/status/1841813395701694559]Level Up KL 2024[/url]: Getting nominated and received an award![/h2]
We attended Level Up KL from October 1-3 at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Center. As one of Southeast Asia’s largest annual gaming events, Level Up KL showcases and nominates new and upcoming games. To our surprise, we received the Best Game Design Award for this year! Knowing our hard work has paid off, we’re more excited than ever to continue developing and bringing you the best of Kriegsfront Tactics!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/c50493f8854f4821c9c1ed896cc41b0dd99553cc.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://x.com/togeproductions/status/1844698659323298272]PAX Aus 2024[/url]: Returning to PAX Aus, the second tactical showcase! [/h2]
It’s been a while since Toge Productions last attended PAX Australia, but this year we had the chance to return. The event took place from October 11-13 at the Melbourne Convention Centre. This was our second time showcasing Kriegsfront Tactics at PAX Aus, the first being at PAX Aus 2022. The updated prologue demo created enthusiasm among both our veteran pilots and new recruits. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/17bf188faa208eb8797b1c229138883f9eada172.png[/img]

[h3]A closer look at the Kriegsfront Tactics Booth at PAX Aus 2024. [/h3]
Victory! One of the pilots trying out the recruitment test for Kriegsfront Tactics, he was flawless in mowing down the enemy foes. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/829df23eef8c095e6b1272efa774880c336678e5.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://x.com/togeproductions/status/1847811005893730792]Gamescom Asia 2024[/url]: The final overseas event attended this year.[/h2]
In a previous announcement, we showcased our visit to Gamescom Cologne. In addition, another Gamescom event, Gamescom Asia, took place at the Suntec Singapore Convention Center from October 17-20, 2024. Our booth was filled with eager new recruits excited to try out the prologue demo. Despite this being our first time at Gamescom Asia, we were amazed by the high euphoria and anticipation for Kriegsfront Tactics. The demo was well-received all day long during the event. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/f499bc379662d28d86ba2bdc57a7125858e0effc.jpg[/img]

[h3]A closer look at the Kriegsfront Tactics Booth at Gamescom Asia 2024. [/h3]
A shot of Mr. Kris, CEO of Toge Productions, shows him watching over the booth and exchanging ideas with pilots who stop by. Kriegsfront Tactics has also been one of his passion projects over the years.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/6524a182f01e02a0aeaed80fd94d3025bd26b017.jpg[/img]

[h2]That is all. See you next year![/h2]
Stay tuned, Pilots! We've put a lot of hard work into this project, and we’re thrilled to share even more updates next year. We’re confident it will be even better, packed with more features. As the year comes to a close, we’re signing off. Happy holidays, and see you next year! Keep your eyes peeled, as you never know when the next update will drop!

Nusanesia is a fictional archipelagic motherland in an alternate 1970s during an era of conflict. Foreign imperialists are fighting each other to gain abundant, untouched natural beauty and wealth.[b] Taking various aspects from real-life counterparts of Southeast Asia, we create a brand-new setting that involves mechs (read: Krieger).[/b] This is an era where the use of mechs is already at the same level as using heavy machinery. Kriegers exist with a pilot that can do construction work, materials extraction, transportation of goods, and the most profitable interest of them all, war. 

[b]Kriegsfront Tactics will offer turn-based mecha squad tactics with destructible mecha parts.[/b] If one of your parts breaks down, you can build it again using various parts from different manufacturers with their own specialty. [b]Experience a combination of classic tactical strategy games and roguelike elements like never before.[/b] Enjoy the lowpoly retro-style visuals that we handcrafted, where you can freely change the settings to be more classic or modern looking.

Inside Kriegsfront Battlescaper, build your own mech in Krieger builder, make personalized unique levels with our level editor, and use the photo mode to show off your favorite scene. 

[b]Come and let’s create your ideal mecha battle diorama.[/b]
